clue.text: To fall back, a mistake made by soldiers

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is the usual crossword abbreviation for soldiers
a lapse is a slip or mistake

explanation.surface: A retreating army blunders: the troops make an error and fall back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made by' puts the soldiers' letters before the mistake.
explanation.definitionFit: To relapse is to slide back into a former, usually worse, condition.

clue.text: English queen, one Lear got involved with

indicators.note: the words get tangled up together, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A royal romance: an English queen became entangled with King Lear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'got involved' rearranges ONE LEAR; 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleanor of Aquitaine and Eleanor of Castile were both queens consort of English kings.

clue.text: Empty new flat on the top floor?

indicators.note: a new version of the word is a fresh arrangement of its letters

parts.note: an empty thing holds nothing, shown as the round letter O

explanation.surface: An estate agent advertises a vacant, newly built apartment on the top floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges O (from 'Empty') with FLAT. The question mark marks the definition as loose: a loft is a top-floor flat.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloft means up high, as one would be living in a top-storey loft.

clue.text: Ring someone who is out

definitions.meaning: a small plain earring worn to keep a newly pierced hole open
a person out cold, fast asleep

explanation.definitionFit: One word covers both a stud-like earring that keeps a piercing open and a person who is asleep.

clue.text: Sea mist represented by painter

indicators.note: the letters of the sea mist are portrayed in a different arrangement

explanation.surface: A painter depicts a sea mist on canvas.
explanation.definitionFit: Henri Matisse was a leading French artist of the Fauvist movement.

clue.text: However, the direction doesn't matter

definitions.meaning: a sentence adverb meaning nevertheless or in any case
read as two words, any route at all will do

explanation.definitionFit: As one word it means nonetheless; split in two it means whichever route you like.

clue.text: Introduced new dietitian

indicators.note: a new form of the word dietitian is its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A newly hired nutrition expert is introduced to colleagues.
explanation.definitionFit: Initiated means admitted or brought in to something, as a newcomer is introduced to it.

clue.text: Alcoholic drink is for the non-driver

definitions.meaning: a cocktail of brandy, orange liqueur and lemon juice
the passenger compartment attached to a motorcycle

explanation.surface: Advice that a strong cocktail is only for someone who won't be driving.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a brandy cocktail and the passenger car bolted to a motorbike.

clue.text: Erring dogs ran loose — they play in the streets

indicators.note: the letters run free and come back in a new order

explanation.surface: Wayward dogs run loose while street performers play nearby.
explanation.definitionFit: Barrel-organ players were traditional street musicians, cranking a handle for passers-by.

clue.text: The lady's ring is one much admired

parts.note: her is the possessive for a woman
a ring is round like the letter O

explanation.surface: A woman's engagement ring is much admired by everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: A hero is a person idolised for courage or achievement.

clue.text: The Archaeopteryx, for instance, are in good time for breakfast

definitions.meaning: a prehistoric flier, among the first feathered creatures
people who rise early and arrive promptly

explanation.definitionFit: Literally the first birds in evolutionary history, and idiomatically people who get up or arrive early.

clue.text: Popular move, building arch

parts.note: something popular is in
a step is a move, as in a dance

explanation.surface: A popular plan to build an arch is a step forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arch' is the noun for the curve of the foot, not a stone arch.
explanation.definitionFit: The instep is the arched middle part of the foot's upper surface.

clue.text: In emergency, use a bugging device and move slowly

parts.note: a tap is a listening device on a phone line
to inch is to creep forward bit by bit

explanation.surface: Spy-thriller advice: when in trouble, plant a bug and edge away slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means if absolutely necessary, when hard pressed.

clue.text: Exploded with fury when there's commission to pay

parts.note: broke as in a storm broke or burst
rage means fury

explanation.surface: Someone explodes in fury on discovering the commission they must pay.
explanation.definitionFit: Brokerage is the fee charged by a broker for arranging a deal.

clue.text: Look out and foil the pickpockets?

definitions.meaning: to stand guard and stay alert
hang on to your timepiece so thieves can't take it

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means stand guard, and literally it means retain your wristwatch.

clue.text: Wife returns, about to be angry

indicators.note: the turned title goes around the little word to
the title is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: Mrs is the title of a married woman

explanation.surface: A wife comes home, on the verge of losing her temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' looks like the wife coming home, but it reverses her title to SRM; 'about' then wraps it round TO, and the definition is a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To storm is to rage or rant furiously.

clue.text: One has two members in support

definitions.text: One has two members in support

parts.words: One has two members in support
parts.note: a creature that stands on a pair of legs

explanation.surface: A political figure is backed by two Members of Parliament.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members' means limbs, not MPs: a creature held up on two legs.
explanation.definitionFit: Any animal walking on two legs, such as a human, fits the description.

clue.text: I find reformed smoker irritating

indicators.note: the smoker is re-formed, its letters put in a new order

explanation.surface: Someone finds a self-righteous ex-smoker irritating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reformed' rearranges SMOKER into RKSOME; 'find' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Irksome means annoying or tiresome.

clue.text: How to leave a waiter a meagre gratuity?

definitions.text: How to leave a waiter a meagre gratuity?

parts.words: How to leave a waiter a meagre gratuity?
parts.note: slip a little cash on the table and hurry off

explanation.surface: A diner wonders how to get away with tipping the waiter badly.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase is also a casual form of cricket in which a batter must run whenever the ball is hit.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaving a small tip and dashing out is a literal reading of the cricket game's name.

clue.text: Purchase a hundred and twenty-four sheets of paper

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
a quire is 24 or 25 sheets, a twentieth of a ream

explanation.surface: A stationery order: buy a hundred and twenty-four sheets of paper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a hundred and twenty-four' looks like 124 but splits into A, a hundred, and a 24-sheet quantity.
explanation.definitionFit: To acquire something is to obtain it, for instance by buying it.

clue.text: Green still on remand

definitions.meaning: a prisoner held awaiting a hearing in court

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both inexperienced and not yet brought to trial.

clue.text: Be amazed at music, originally a Ravel composition

indicators.note: the origin of the word music is its opening letter
the letters of Ravel are composed into a new order

explanation.surface: Wonder at music which turns out to be a piece by Ravel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally' takes the first letter of 'music'; 'composition' rearranges RAVEL; 'a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To marvel is to be filled with wonder or astonishment.

clue.text: Spotted horse that's white — not black

definitions.text: Spotted horse that's white — not black

parts.words: Spotted horse that's white — not black
parts.note: a horse with patches of white and some colour other than black

explanation.surface: Describing a patchy horse: white markings, but no black.
explanation.walkthrough: A piebald has black and white patches; this term covers white with any other colour, such as brown.
explanation.definitionFit: The term names a horse with white patches on a coat of a colour other than black.

clue.text: No score in even game

indicators.note: the zero sits inside the word for being square

parts.note: quits means square, with nothing owed either way
a score of nothing, zero, is the letter O

explanation.surface: A match ends goalless, so the game finishes level.
explanation.definitionFit: Quoits is a game of throwing rings over a peg.

clue.text: There's nothing sinful about her

parts.note: zero, the letter O

indicators.note: the word for wicked is turned about, read backwards

parts.note: evil means wicked or sinful

explanation.surface: A defence of a woman's character: she has no sins at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns EVIL into LIVE. 'her' stands for a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Olive is a woman's first name, so it can stand for the pronoun naming a woman.

clue.text: Composer to drive men to distraction

indicators.note: driven to distraction, the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A composer's music drives men mad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to distraction' rearranges TO DRIVE MEN; the first 'to' is part of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Claudio Monteverdi was an Italian composer, a pioneer of opera.

clue.text: Divine lady currently in Oxford

definitions.meaning: a current is a flowing river, here the stretch of the Thames at Oxford

explanation.walkthrough: 'currently' hints at a river current: the Thames through Oxford is locally called by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to the Egyptian goddess and to the River Thames as it passes through Oxford.

clue.text: Yale's entrance requirement

parts.note: a Yale is a make of lock, which needs an opening for its key

explanation.surface: What it takes to get admitted to Yale University.
explanation.walkthrough: Yale is not the American university but a well-known brand of door lock.
explanation.definitionFit: A lock's slot for its key is the way in that any Yale lock needs.

clue.text: Member finishes the accounts

parts.note: a leg is a limb, or member, of the body
ends means finishes

explanation.surface: A member of staff completes the annual accounts.
explanation.definitionFit: Legends are traditional stories or tales handed down.
